title: Relock Days in Larkspur's Re-Send Standard — Closing and Funding
content:
**Standard.** After a Larkspur-side return on a Closing and Funding closing, the relock days of Larkspur's re-send standard are set from the borrower's Rate Lock Commitment. The lock's expiration before any relock is the new expiration date of its latest extension, or its original expiration date where it was never extended.

| Lock's expiration before any relock | Relock request logged | Relock days |
|---|---|---|
| on or after the return date and no later than the last day of the re-send and re-review days, so that the re-send needed a relock | after the lock's lock desk cutoff time | the lock's confirmation business days plus one |
| the lock lapsed in that span | no later than the lock desk cutoff time | the lock's confirmation business days |
| any other case | | none |

The last day of the re-send and re-review days is reached by counting the re-send days plus the re-review days in business days, Monday through Friday, starting with the day after the return date; with no such days it is the return date itself. The records read are the Rate Lock Commitment's extension entries (the new expiration date of the latest one) or, with none, its original expiration date; the time stamp of the relock request in the lock's request log; and the lock's own lock desk cutoff time and confirmation business days.

A wire return is Larkspur-side when the settlement agent rejected a wire whose amount differs from the amount of the wire that funded the loan (Larkspur's wrong amount), or when Larkspur recalled the wire because a prior-to-funding item was open (a return marked as funding conditions unmet). The wire that funded the loan is the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date, and the return looked at is the closing's latest wire return.

## Cases (hypothetical; return on Monday the 4th, re-send and re-review days totalling 2, so the span ends Wednesday the 6th; lock desk cutoff 16:00, confirmation 1 business day)

| Original expiration | Latest extension's new expiration | Relock request time | Relock days |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 5th | none | 16:20 | 2 |
| the 6th | none | 15:30 | 1 |
| the 1st | the 4th | 16:00 | 1 |
| the 1st | the 9th | any | none (the extended lock had not lapsed within the span) |
| the 5th | the 12th | any | none (the latest extension governs, not the original date) |
| the 3rd | none | any | none (it lapsed before the return date) |
